title: Spx 500 -- No New Thing Under The Sun
author: hairy_zub
selftext:
>[**Isaiah 43:18-19**](https://www.tradingview.com/x/MvmnH89g/) *Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.* *Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.*

>**1 Timothy 6:20** *Keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:*

>**Revelation 22:7** *Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.*
